english.title: Breach SHPO / interim SHPO
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[did something, namely,**(..SPECIFY THING DONE..), which you were prohibited from doing]_
(B)_[failed to do something, namely **(..SPECIFY THING NOT DONE..), which was a thing that you were required to do]_

by

(C)_[a sexual harm prevention order made under section 103A]_
(D)_[an interim sexual harm prevention order made under section 103F]_

of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER OR INTERIM ORDER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 103I(A1) and (3) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable excuse
did anything prohibited by or
failed to do something required by
SHPO / interim SHPO

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where a person is convicted of an offence under section 103I(4), it is not open to the court by or before which the person is convicted to make, in respect of the offence, an order for conditional discharge.
(ii) This offence relates to a breach of an SHPO made under sections 103A to 103K of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
(iii) For the offence for breaches occurring prior to 29/11/22 see offence H11483.
(iv) For breaches of SHPOs made under section 345 of the Sentencing Act 2020, see offence H101093.
